Let \(H=H_0^1(0,1)\) with inner product
\[
\langle u,v\rangle=\int_0^1 u'(x)v'(x)\,dx .
\]
The point evaluation \(u\mapsto u(1/2)\) is represented by the Green function
\[
G(x)=
\begin{cases}
x/2,&0\le x\le 1/2,\\
(1-x)/2,&1/2\le x\le 1,
\end{cases}
\]
so that \(u(1/2)=\langle u,G\rangle\), and
\[
\|G\|^2=G(1/2)=\frac14.
\]

The two moment constraints are also inner products. If
\[
-\phi_1''=x,\qquad -\phi_3''=x^3,\qquad \phi_1(0)=\phi_1(1)=\phi_3(0)=\phi_3(1)=0,
\]
then
\[
\phi_1(x)=\frac{x-x^3}{6},\qquad \phi_3(x)=\frac{x-x^5}{20},
\]
and
\[
\int_0^1 xu=\langle u,\phi_1\rangle,\qquad
\int_0^1 x^3u=\langle u,\phi_3\rangle.
\]
Thus \(V=\operatorname{span}(\phi_1,\phi_3)^\perp\).

The sharp constant is the squared norm of the projection of \(G\) onto \(V\):
\[
C=\|G\|^2-b^T A^{-1}b,
\]
where
\[
A=
\begin{pmatrix}
\langle \phi_1,\phi_1\rangle & \langle \phi_1,\phi_3\rangle\\
\langle \phi_3,\phi_1\rangle & \langle \phi_3,\phi_3\rangle
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\frac1{45} & \frac1{105}\\
\frac1{105} & \frac1{225}
\end{pmatrix},
\]
and
\[
b=
\begin{pmatrix}
\langle G,\phi_1\rangle\\
\langle G,\phi_3\rangle
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\int_0^1 xG(x)\,dx\\
\int_0^1 x^3G(x)\,dx
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\frac1{16}\\
\frac3{128}
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Now
\[
\det A=\frac4{496125},
\]
and
\[
b^TA^{-1}b
=
\frac{13545}{65536}.
\]
Therefore
\[
C=\frac14-\frac{13545}{65536}
=\frac{16384-13545}{65536}
=\frac{2839}{65536}.
\]

Sharpness holds because equality is attained by taking \(u\) proportional to the projection of \(G\) onto \(V\).

\[
\boxed{\frac{2839}{65536}}
\]
